name: Breaker
lead: What took a block out, and with what.

fields.name: cause
fields.description: What took the block out: a player, fire, an explosion, flowing water, or the loss of what held it up ("support").

fields.name: tool
fields.description: The item in hand, or nil for a bare hand and for the four causes that have none.

fields.name: creative
fields.description: Whether a creative player broke it; creative takes the block and leaves nothing. False for the four causes with no player.
